comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides read channel SoCs, preamplifiers, and custom flash controllers for HDD and SSD OEMs to manage data storage and access.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose specific storage technologies and their role in OEM SSD solutions. Micron (MU) focuses on the memory cell technology itself, specifically announcing shipments of its densest OEM production QLC NAND with improved density and access times in 2024. In contrast, Broadcom (AVGO) describes its role as a provider of custom flash controllers to SSD OEMs, which manage the underlying flash memory (such as NAND) to perform critical functions like error correction and wear leveling. While MU produces the storage media (NAND), AVGO provides the controller silicon that manages it, indicating a complementary relationship within the same SSD supply chain segment.

sentences.text: In 2024, we announced shipments of our densest OEM production QLC NAND, built on this technology, with improved storage density and access times.
We also provide custom flash controllers to SSD OEMs. An SSD stores data in flash memory instead of on a hard disk, providing high speed access to the data.

Flash controllers manage the underlying flash memory in SSDs, performing critical functions such as reading and writing data to and from the flash memory and performing error correction, wear leveling and bad block management.

comparisons.peer_topic: Intel 4 process node production status and capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel 4, the first EUV lithography node, delivered significant density scaling and approximately 20% performance-per-watt improvement over Intel 7; it moved to high-volume manufacturing in Ireland in 2024 for the Intel Core Ultra processor and is expected to represent an increasing portion of production in 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address physical density improvements in advanced technologies, but focus on different hardware layers. Micron (MU) highlights 'improved storage density' achieved through its new OEM production QLC NAND technology, which is a memory storage product. Intel (INTC) discusses 'density scaling' as a key benefit of its Intel 4 process node, which is a semiconductor manufacturing logic technology for processors (specifically the Intel Core Ultra). While both cite density scaling as a technical achievement, MU's density refers to bit storage capacity per cell in NAND flash, whereas INTC's density refers to transistor packing on a logic chip.

sentences.text: In 2024, we announced shipments of our densest OEM production QLC NAND, built on this technology, with improved storage density and access times.

▪Intel 4, our first EUV lithography node, delivers significant density scaling and approximately 20% performance-per-watt improvement over Intel 7. The Intel Core Ultra processor is our first high-volume client product on Intel 4 and began shipping to customers in 2023. Intel 4 moved to high-volume manufacturing in Ireland in 2024, and is expected to represent an increasing portion of our processor production and products in 2025.
